prose.en: All the nouns and adjectives in this unit always begin with a capital letter, for example Africa [NOT africa].
It is not possible to show all the countries of the world on a small page. If your country is not included, check its English name with your teacher.
Many country adjectives end in ish.
A few country adjectives end in ese.
Exceptions: French (from France), Dutch (from Holland), Swiss (from Switzerland), Greek, Iraqi, Thai, Icelandic, Arab, Israeli
Words for languages are usually the same as the 'people' adjective: English, French, Japanese, Thai, Spanish, Chinese, Norwegian (from Norway), etc. There is one exception: Arabic.

note: Left page contains teaching prose: unit intro note, explanatory note under countries map, adjective-ending notes (table left column), exceptions line, and section D prose. Right page is exercises only (excluded).
